name: skills
one_liner: A set of official, Google-written cheat sheets that teach AI coding assistants the correct, current way to build Android apps.
buyer: No real external buyer — this is Google's own documentation-as-code for Android developers using AI tools, given away for free.
business_use_cases: An Android dev shop installs the skills so their AI pair-programmer stops suggesting outdated Jetpack Compose patterns.
A coding bootcamp teaching mobile development uses the skills to keep student AI assistants aligned with current best practices.
A contracting agency cites use of these official skills as a quality signal to prospective Android-app clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid Android-modernization audits for client codebases, using these skills to flag outdated patterns.

steal_this: There's no product to build here — it's free official documentation maintained by Google. The honest move is to just use it, not try to monetize it directly.
